description: Undo an entity-handle alias merge: every memory the merge retagged that is live, unpinned, still carries the canonical handle and does not already carry `from` gets it back through memory::update, and the pair is recorded as distinct so no pass merges it again.

from.description: The handle the merge retagged away.

skipped.description: Recorded memories left alone: gone, retired, pinned, no longer carrying `to`, already carrying `from`, or carrying more than eight handles.

to.description: The handle the merge had retagged to.
